lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  have h0 : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_ne_of_le (fun he => hx₀ (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp he.symm)) real_inner_self_nonneg'
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := Continuous.inner' f _ hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ, 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (hc.continuousAt.eventually (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds h0))
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ0, half_lt_self hδ0⟩
  have hφ : IsTestFunction (φ : Y → ℝ) := ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩
  have key := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀) (IsTestFunction.smul_right hφ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  have hp : 0 ≤ fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := fun x => by
    rcases eq_or_ne (φ x) 0 with h | h
    · simp [h]
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hδ x (φ.support_eq ▸ h)).le
  have hcp : Continuous (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := Continuous.mul φ.continuous hc
  have hi : Integrable (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) μ :=
    hcp.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hφ.supp.mul_right
  have hz : (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) = 0 :=
    Measure.eq_of_ae_eq ((integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hp hi).mp key) hcp continuous_zero
  exact absurd (congrFun hz x₀) ((mul_pos (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ0)) h0).ne')
